recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if the Vocabulary/Terminology Infrastructure work group redefines VSD CLD terminology for the modern split between ValueSet.compose and separate CodeSystem resources.
issue_request: FHIR-5944 was a Published/Persuasive Vocabulary issue asking FHIR to clarify which ValueSet elements constitute the VSD Content Logical Definition; the historical DSTU1 resolution said ValueSet.define plus ValueSet.compose made up the CLD.
initial_application: The historical application appears to be commit 8c3627f2, which added ValueSet narrative saying that compose and define made up the VSD Content Logical definition. The commit did not name FHIR-5944, but the content matches the issue request and timing.
additional_context: Later ValueSet model changes superseded the literal element names in the seed. FHIR-8354 renamed ValueSet.define to ValueSet.codeSystem, and the 2016 CodeSystem split removed inline code systems from ValueSet. The current build has separate active ValueSet and CodeSystem resources.
reconciliation: No source change was made because reintroducing define/codeSystem wording would be stale. Current ValueSet narrative and StructureDefinition source already identify ValueSet.compose as the VSD Content Logical Definition/CLD, and current source has no active ValueSet.define or ValueSet.codeSystem element.

related_jiras.note: Renamed ValueSet.define to ValueSet.codeSystem before later source changes removed inline code systems from ValueSet.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive Vocabulary issue requesting clarification of which ValueSet elements constitute the VSD Content Logical Definition, resolved as ValueSet.define plus ValueSet.compose for DSTU1.
